frozen_market_logic.representation: daily causal cost-resolved equal-notional event bars calibrated only from the preceding completed UTC day

frozen_market_logic.pullback: first completed event with opposite aggressive flow and adverse price change while outside value and the selected expansion target remain intact
frozen_market_logic.entry: NautilusTrader STOP_LIMIT one 0.1 BTC tick beyond the completed pullback extreme with a 7bp worst-fill cap
frozen_market_logic.invalidation: completed counterflow pullback swing plus one 7bp buffer
frozen_market_logic.primary_target: second completed 20-event structure-width expansion node beyond the accepted boundary
frozen_market_logic.single_ablation: first-expansion-control uses the first expansion node; detector, entry, invalidation, risk, cost and holding rules are identical
frozen_market_logic.auction_rationale: the initial initiative already traverses part of the first expansion before a pullback-break entry can exist; the primary tests the next unconsumed expansion node of the new resumption leg
frozen_market_logic.pending_cancel: cancel when target or pullback-swing invalidation trades before entry, or when the causal remaining response window expires
